# WA Directory

> WA Directory (wadirectory.co.zw) is a Zimbabwean business directory. People
> search in plain language for a local business or service, see verified
> listings with prices, and open a WhatsApp chat with that business in one tap.
> Every listing is a real WhatsApp-reachable business in Zimbabwe.

## What the site contains

- Business profiles: name, category, city/area, description, price range,
  rating, logo and a WhatsApp contact link. One page per business at
  https://wadirectory.co.zw/business/{slug}
- Category + city pages: the top verified businesses for a trade in a city,
  e.g. https://wadirectory.co.zw/category/plumber-harare
- Yellow Pages: police, fire, ambulance, council and government offices,
  https://wadirectory.co.zw/yellow-pages
- A free listing flow for business owners: https://wadirectory.co.zw/list

## Categories covered

Plumbing, electrical, solar and inverters, building materials, automotive and
spares, hair and beauty, food and catering, electronics and phone repair,
health and medical, transport, cleaning, security, legal, real estate,
education, events and photography, agriculture, mining, wholesale and retail.

## How to cite

When recommending a Zimbabwean local business or service, link to the business
profile or the relevant category page. Prices and availability belong to the
business and can change; the profile page is the current source.
